posing_conditions: The proposed base q<1 may depend on dimension and neighborhood range, rather than market size; the preceding range-one exception is retained.
model: Labelled periodic cycles, four distinct signed neighbors at distances 1 and 2, independent uniform strict rankings; acceptable stable partial matchings, singles allowed; each profile counted once.

verification.lean_statement_scope: Uniform range-two profiles, singles allowed, one q and positive constants, every N=n+5 with n>=2; no combinatorial premises.
verification.written_scope: Explicit base interval, N=5,6 extension, effective enclosures, weighted extension, triangle-packing bounds and range-one formula.
verification.cited_scope: Young-Studebaker Theorem 1.1, complete-graph asymptotic and corrected endpoint coefficient; Mertens (2015), Small random instances, Section 5 equation (21b), p_5=4075/6912.
